translations.web: Then little children were brought to him, that he should lay his hands on them and pray; and the disciples rebuked them.
translations.bsb: Then little children were brought to Jesus for Him to place His hands on them and pray for them. And the disciples rebuked those who brought them.
translations.kjv: Then were there brought unto him little children, that he should put his hands on them, and pray: and the disciples rebuked them.
